IGUI_GS_AddonCraftDesc: Craft add-on: magazine required (Electricity 5). Install module on this terminal.
IGUI_GS_CraftRemoteHint: Open the game crafting UI; network containers are added while you have terminal access.
IGUI_GS_CraftSendResultHint: When ON, whatever the crafting produces (and any leftover materials) is sent to network storage by priority instead of staying in your inventory. Tools already return automatically either way.
IGUI_GSSIK_CraftOperationFailedReturned: Crafting failed: {1}. Borrowed items will be returned to storage.
IGUI_GSSIK_CraftFailClaimTimeout: materials did not arrive in time
IGUI_GSSIK_CraftFailStart: the game could not start the action
IGUI_GSSIK_CraftFailInvalid: the recipe is no longer valid
IGUI_GSSIK_CraftFailBatchMaterials: there are not enough materials for the requested batch
IGUI_GSSIK_CraftFailCoreUpdate: Global Storage Core is outdated; update Core before crafting batches
